wired: worklog.md (r162 onward: every wave entry declares its evaluator — LOOP-3 self-demonstrated)
statusRationale: Reef is the reference implementation of the fleet's own wave loop (serve/observe/grow/commit). Running reef-infra needs an OpenAI-style endpoint we do not host plus another always-on Python service; the doctrine is adopted, the infra is watchlisted.

mappingToFleet.observe: revenue-census (26h freshness gate) · capability-census · VP curve · worklog
mappingToFleet.commit: git anchor-rebase → commit → push · feature_list.json · init.sh gates
mappingToFleet.evaluate: census verdicts V1-V6 · tsc/eslint · on-chain receipts · operator approval for policy
mappingToFleet.revert: git revert + rebase-anchor · guard packs (sovereign-guard r153)

rules.doctrine: Every improvement cycles the same four stations: serve (produce value), observe (record interactions + outcomes), grow (produce a candidate change), commit (apply a selection policy and publish). A wave that skips a station is not a wave — it is an edit.

A candidate is judged against the CURRENT harness on the SAME tasks in fresh runs; it publishes only when it wins more than it loses, by a pre-declared margin. Before/after stories without a control are anecdotes, not evidence.
propose/evaluate are two separate contracts: a change wave must name its evaluator and pass criteria BEFORE making the edit. Post-hoc metrics chosen after seeing results are disqualified.
A rejected candidate reverts fully to the snapshot — automatically, without ceremony. Cheap reverts are what make bold candidates safe to try. (Ours: git anchors + rebase + guard packs.)

Every failure that escapes (a bug, a false-positive gate, a missed receipt) joins the permanent task suite as a gate/check after screening — the suite only grows. (Proven here: the init.sh false-positive became a gate; the census bugs became the fill_vesting_withdraw + units checks.)

Published wins are re-scored periodically against the grown suite; a publish that a newer suite scores as regression gets rolled back. Nothing stays 'done' by seniority. (Ours: census 26h freshness + verdict re-runs each wave.)

Episodes run without host credentials and without network beyond what the task needs. The learner never holds the keychain. (Ours: sovereign-guard packs; scan/learn targets are clean checkouts — SEC-4.)

activationRoutes: endpoint-appears: an OpenAI-style inference endpoint we control → reef-infra serve + native harness loop against a clean fleet checkout (harness surface only, no GPU)
gpu-appears: weight-surface recipes (sdft/sdpo/sao) become evaluable — re-judge against revenue impact first
reef-eval-integration: if task-suite automation is wanted before an endpoint, reef-eval (separate repo) is the scorer to study next
